text:
maria: Heads-up: staging GPUs failing to pull keys after midnight — keystore 403s -> nodes stuck in provisioning. Anyone else seeing this?
aj: seeing it in eu-west-1 too, warm-pool nodes won't join.
devon: looks like the egress hardening change landed in staging earlier today — egress SG now restricts to 10.0.0.0/8 only. That blocks privatelink IPs for keystore/keystore-proxy.
sre-jen: ops-bot flagged a merged PR from infra automation: #4321 changed sg-egress-policy and auto-deploy ran. Can we rollback? :grimacing: 
ops-bot: deploybot: merged infra/sg-egress-policy @ 3090008900 by infra-bot. Auto-deploy initiated.
samir: if warm pools keep failing we'll start spilling GPUs to other regions which will blow egress budget. Need a quick patch.
devon: logs:
```
ERR: kms.Decrypt 403 unauthorized for role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gpu-node-role
keystore 10.11.12.13: connection refused / policy denied
pod gpu-warm-1: FailedToStart: decrypt error: permission denied
```
aj: quick mitigation: add keystore privatelink CIDR 10.11.12.0/24 back to sg-egress in staging; is that acceptable for compliance as a temporary exception?
sre-jen: compliance wants every security change recorded. If we patch or rollback, include who did it, why, and attach the runbook. Also FYI, extra audit log events being emitted to S3 for this window will add ~ $200/mo to storage at current retention.
devon: I can push a scoped patch and open a rollback PR with clear justification and runbook.
maria: also seeing a subset of nodes in us-west-2 failing on HSM handshake after a recent HSM endpoint rotation; role boundary likely didn't include the new key ARN. Might be separate but related to key access hardening.
samir: cost note: if we failover and reprovision in another region we estimate ~ $1.2k/day in cross-region egress for the current traffic profile. Avoid if possible.
aj: pushing a scoped change to allow keystore privatelink/keystore-proxy CIDR and restart warm pool. PR: infra#4337 (small allowlist).
ops-bot: auditlog: change infra/sg-egress-policy by aj @ 3090011200 — patch applied to staging sandbox.
maria: after adding CIDR, nodes started rejoining. 12/20 healthy now, warming. Still watching for decrypt transient errors. :thumbsup: 
sre-jen: please add post-incident notes: action items — (1) map privatelink IPs into allowed egress for all staging clusters, (2) gating check for infra auto-merges that touch egress/security rules, (3) simulate privatelink/hsm key rotation in staging. I'll file a ticket.
devon: also recommend adding a cost alert for cross-region egress > $500/day for GPU clusters (infra#4340).
samir: +1 on the alert. Schedule on-call for next HSM rotation window so we're ready.
maria: thanks everyone. tagging security team for audit/retention guidance: @sec-ops — can you confirm acceptable retention and who signs off on temporary allowlists?
sec-ops (placeholder): noted, will comment on the ticket with retention guidance and approval flow.
